back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, the Lord GOD says this to the land of Israel: The end has come! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
Now the end is upon you, and I will release My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
My eye will not spare you, and I will not have pity; but I will punish you for your ways, and your abominations will be in your midst. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
The Lord GOD says this: Disaster! An unprecedented disaster—behold, it is coming!
The end has come! The end has come; it has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!
Doom has come upon you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near—a day of panic, not of shouts of joy on the mountains.
Now, very soon, I will pour out My wrath upon you and spend My anger against you to the full; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
My eye will not spare, and I will not have pity; I will punish you for your ways, and your abominations will be in your midst. Then you will know that I am the LORD who strikes.
Behold, the day! Behold, it has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.
Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness; none of them will remain—neither their multitude, nor their wealth, nor their eminence.
The time has come, the day has arrived; let not the buyer rejoice and let not the seller mourn, for fierce wrath is upon the whole multitude.
For the seller will not get back what he sold while both remain alive, for the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked; and because of his iniquity, no one will preserve his life.
They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes out to battle, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the field will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
Those who survive will flee to the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each one for his own iniquity.
Every hand will go limp, and every knee will become weak as water.
They will put on sackcloth, and horror will cover them; shame will be on every face, and every head will be shaved bald.

They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an unclean thing; their silver and gold cannot save them on the day of the wrath of the LORD; it cannot satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, for it became the stumbling block of their iniquity.
Their beautiful ornaments they used in pride, and made from them their abominable images and detestable idols; therefore I will make these into an unclean thing for them.
I will give them as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, and they will defile them.
I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place; robbers will enter it and defile it.
Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses; I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be defiled.
Anguish is coming; they will seek peace, but there will be none.
Disaster will come upon disaster, and rumor upon rumor; they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction will perish from the priest and counsel from the elders.

The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble with fear. I will deal with them according to their ways, and I will judge them by their own standards. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
